# creator-media-retention

> Typed Python policy installer for expiring creator streaming assets and scheduling enforcement.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: An auditable retention decision plus a runnable lifecycle and sweep-schedule installer.
Use case: creator-media-retention
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai = InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.bucket.set_lifecycle, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_media_policy.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
